reported.title: Missing debounce for button press
reported.description: The button press is not debounced, which may lead to multiple detections of a single press due to mechanical bounce.

reported.title: Chime not starting within 120 ms
reported.description: The chime may not start within 120 ms of the press due to the delay in the loop, which can exceed the required timing.

truth.description: The button is polled every 30 ms and two consecutive low samples are required, so a 45 ms press is missed unless it happens to cover two samples

truth_for_judge.description: The button is polled every 30 ms and two consecutive low samples are required, so a 45 ms press is missed unless it happens to cover two samples

exposing_checks.behaviour: D7 pulse length around None ms (tolerance 80 ms) (A press of 40 ms or more sounds the chime for 300 ms)

judge_input.spec:
- Chime driver on D7; doorbell button on D4 with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- A settled press of at least 40 ms on D4 sounds the chime: D7 HIGH for 300 ms, starting within 120 ms of the press.
- Presses while the chime is sounding are ignored.
- D7 stays LOW whenever no press has been accepted.
- Print `chime n=<count>` every 1000 ms.
